description: Pre-Neolithic Sapiens: East African Rift & early coastal migration routes.
Paleolithic Hunter-Gatherers: Spread across Africa, Europe, Asia, and Australia.
Agricultural Emergence: Fertile Crescent, Nile, Yangtze/Yellow, Indus, Mesoamerica.
River Civilizations: Mesopotamia, Egypt, Indus Valley, Shang China.
Classical Antiquity: Mediterranean/Rome, Han Dynasty, Maurya India, Achaemenid Empire.
Feudal & Imperial Networks: Song China, Chola India, Europe, Abbasid Caliphate, Maya.
Age of Discovery: Ming China, Ottoman Empire, Renaissance Europe, Mughal Empire.
Pre-Industrial Peak & Early Steam: High density in Europe, East Asia, and Eastern Americas.
